content.comment_body: Hello, I have an urgent question. Is it possible to connect [product_name] with Labview? For instance, if input I3 of [product_name] is on, can Labview read that status over Ethernet/IP? If this is doable, how can I achieve it?
Thank you for your answer. Does this procedure also work with a [product_name] [article_no] (with display)?

You can use the reverse engineered protocol mentioned earlier. Alternatively, you may use the NI Modbus library (available in VIPM), which supports Modbus/TCP connections. Choose the option that best fits your setup.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking if and how [product_name] can be connected to Labview via Ethernet to monitor specific input states, and is seeking step-by-step guidance and clarification on compatibility. Responses reference using the reverse engineered protocol or Modbus/TCP through NI libraries, but do not provide detailed instructions or confirm which [product_name] versions are compatible. This leaves some uncertainty for users with urgent or specific requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear and reliable instructions for monitoring [product_name] input states within Labview through Ethernet/IP, including confirmation of compatibility with the specific [product_name] version.
